summary: Implemented deterministic offline lifecycle regression gates for crypto numeric paper lifecycle replay. The gate command validates locked aggregate outcomes, ensures the settled-no bad entry remains not-filled, verifies no-action/rejected scenarios do not create paper orders, preserves winning fills, and locks all safety flags.
limitations: Validates deterministic fixture replay output only; no live markets, prices, APIs, or external metadata are fetched.
Regression gates lock current offline paper lifecycle outcomes and safety flags.
The command is local review/CI-style validation only and does not add runtime wiring.
No runtime integration, dispatcher/run_codex, prompt automation, credentials, wallet access, real orders, live trading, unrelated cleanup, or new validation layer was added.
recommended_next_task: PMBOT-BRAIN-015: add an offline paper lifecycle audit report that explains why each regression gate passed or failed for operator review.
